user.title: Switch Timer
user.description: Adds Switch Timer to Home Assistant. You only do this once: timers are created automatically when you pick a switch in a Switch Timer card.

create_entry.default: Switch Timer is ready. Reload this page (F5) once to load the Switch Timer card, then add it to a dashboard and pick a switch. Timers are created automatically.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Switch Timer is already set up.

data_description.run_time_min: Lowest value of the run time number.
data_description.run_time_max: Highest value of the run time number.
data_description.run_time_step: How much the run time changes per step.
data_description.default_run_time: Minutes a run lasts when no time is given.
data_description.extend_minutes: Minutes added by extend when no time is given.

error.max_not_above_min: The maximum must be greater than the minimum.
error.default_out_of_range: The default run time must be between the minimum and the maximum.

abort.no_timers: There are no timers yet. Pick a switch in a Switch Timer card to create one.

entity_not_managed.message: {entity_id} is not controlled by a Switch Timer.

start.name: Start
start.description: Turns the entity on and starts a timed run.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Length of the run. Defaults to the run time number.

extend.name: Extend
extend.description: Adds time to the active timed run. Does nothing without one.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes to add. Defaults to the extend step option.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Turns the entity off and clears the timed run.
